Jess (she/her): Hey folks — clearing out some stuff before my move. I have 2x LG 27\" 4K monitors (model 27QN600). Very gently used. Asking $120 each or take both for $200. Pickup from SoMa office (145 Bryant). Pics: https://imgur.com/example1 :smile:
Miguel: Interested — can you confirm if they have VESA mounts and if the stands are included?
Jess (she/her): Yes VESA 100x100. Stands included but I can remove them if you want to save space for transport.
Tara: I might take both if I can swing pickup Friday after 3pm. Will pm details.
Nate: If Tara flakes, hold one for me? I only need one.
Jess (she/her): Sure Nate I can hold one for you for 24h after Tara confirms. First come first serve though.
Sophie: Quick question — depth of the stand with the base? My desk is shallow.
Jess (she/her): Stand footprint ~9.5\" x 7.8\"; depth from screen to back of base ~7.3\". If you need I can remove stands and pack in my car.
Miguel: $120 seems fair. Would you accept Venmo or cash?
Jess (she/her): Venmo preferred but cash is fine.
Tara: Confirmed — I'll pick both up Friday 4pm. Can you leave them at the front desk and I'll sign for pickup?
Jess (she/her): Yep I can drop them with front desk (please bring ID). I'll also leave a sticky note with my name.
ops-bot: Reminder: Office giveaway items must be logged in the "office-transfers" spreadsheet for audit. Please add a row with item, recipient, and date. http://intranet/office-transfers
Jess (she/her): Thanks ops-bot — added the row.
Nate: If anything falls through, shout here. Also if anyone wants a cheap monitor arm, I have a dual 27\" arm for $40.
Sophie: Ooh DM me about the arm Nate :heart_eyes:
Jess (she/her): closing note — if anyone wants both monitors for free (charity pickup) I can donate after Friday. Otherwise sticking to the $200 for both.
Miguel: Appreciate it — will pass the link to a few friends who might want them. :thumbsup:
Tara: Thanks Jess! See you Friday.
Jess (she/her): Thanks all :wave:
